title: DEGIRO Session
description: Represents an authenticated DEGIRO trading session returned after a successful login.

status.description: Numeric status code for the login result (0 = success)

statusText.description: Human-readable description of the login status

sessionId.description: Opaque session token used as query parameter for subsequent authenticated requests

redirectUrl.description: URL to redirect to after successful login

locale.description: IETF language tag representing the user's locale (e.g. en_GB)

isPassCodeEnabled.description: Whether two-factor passcode authentication is enabled on this account
